classification_scope: the new exact evaluator (arrhenius_fracture.crack_rebonding_v10230.static_shield_phase_resolved_action) itself, validated as numerically correct against an independent fine-stepped reference -- NOT a retroactive re-classification of the already-published static-shield-attribution study (branch codex/v10.2.30-crack-rebonding-static-shield-attribution, commit 767a42a / a72d465), whose static control used the coarser cycle-mean adaptive quadrature (_phase_statistics) and never ran through this exact machinery at all.

frozen_tolerance.metric: relative agreement of the computed phase-resolved action against an independent fine-stepped reference

result: all 108 parametrized (Kmax x K_b x k0 x interval) no-hold cases plus 9 firing-inside-hold cases (Kmax x K_b) passed at the frozen 1e-6 relative tolerance; typical observed discrepancy was floating-point roundoff level, far under the gate
key_property_confirmed: the action contributed by one full cycle is bit-for-bit identical across repeated cycles (no P/C/B or any other state carries over between cycles for a prescribed constant K_b), unlike dynamic rebonding's phase_resolved_action -- so no periodic-orbit bulk-action approximation is needed or applicable here; the evaluator is exact by construction for any interval length once one cycle's action is computed.

retained_qualifications_unaffected.STATIC_DYNAMIC_LOCALIZER_PARITY_UNRESOLV: still the correct label for the EXISTING static-shield-attribution study's published SAT_EXISTING-row numbers -- those did not use this evaluator. This finding makes the exact evaluator available for future studies (e.g. Part X's PX5 static/dynamic attribution stage) to adopt, which could then legitimately claim PRESCRIBED_STATIC_EVENT_LOCALIZATION_PARITY_QUALIFIED for THEMSELVES if they route their static controls through solve_coupled_event_time + static_shield_phase_resolved_action instead of _phase_statistics's coarser mean-based approach.
retained_qualifications_unaffected.FIXED_ABSOLUTE_COHESIVE_SHIELDING_DOMINA: unaffected -- remains scoped only to the existing SAT_EXISTING row per mission_scope.json.

not_done_in_this_pass: wiring static_shield_phase_resolved_action into a live production commit path (analogous to persistent_site_cyclic_energy_gated_v10230.py::_commit_rebonding_event for dynamic rebonding) -- deferred to whichever future study (PX5) actually needs a production static-shield trajectory localized this way; PX1.4's mandate was the evaluator and its qualification, not a new physical study

K_b=0 architectural bypass enforcement at a call site -- there is no call site yet, since production wiring is deferred; the function itself was confirmed not to misbehave at K_b=0 (test_zero_K_b_reduces_to_ordinary_zero_shield_action), but the mission's 'do not route K_b=0 through this path' requirement is an efficiency/architecture decision for whatever future wiring adopts this function, documented in its docstring
